name: Aiden Zhang
intro: Hey, I'm Aiden, a first-year Computer Engineering student at the University of Waterloo. I'm interested in building software, firmware, and hardware, from full-stack applications to computer vision, robotics, and embedded systems. I'm currently on the WARG Autonomy subteam and the WATonomous EVE subteam. I'm looking for a Summer 2027 co-op where I can contribute, learn from others, and keep building.

projects:
Computer Vision Food Recognition & Nutritional Analysis
June 2025 - October 2026
Python, PyTorch, YOLO, OpenCV, NumPy, pandas, TensorFlow
• Built a live webcam app that identifies five food categories and detects multiple items using a fine-tuned YOLO11 model
• Averaged approximately 13.5 FPS across 300 frames. Trained on 245 hand-labelled images and reached 98% mAP50 on a held-out validation set
• Integrated nutrition feedback and text-to-speech, including a five-month pilot with six participants

ROS 2 Behaviour Tree Telemetry Reporter - WARG
September 2026 - November 2026
Python, ROS 2, MAVROS, MAVLink, ArduPilot SITL, Mission Planner, Docker, Git
• Exposed four active behaviour states in Mission Planner by implementing a ROS 2 reporter that selects the deepest RUNNING behaviour tree node and encodes it as a compact MAVLink STATUSTEXT identifier
• Reduced redundant telemetry by publishing on behaviour changes and retransmitting the latest state approximately every 30 seconds
• Verified state detection and ground-station reception using Docker logs, ArduPilot SITL, and Mission Planner during simulated mission transitions

Multi-Drone Deconfliction - WARG
November 2026
Python, PyTest, Git, GitHub
• Built a conflict-detection module that checks every drone's planned flight path against every other drone's and reports any place two come closer than a minimum separation distance
• Wrote a brute-force O(S²) implementation and a sweep-and-prune O(S log S + C) implementation that skips drones that are far apart
• Cross-checked both implementations on 200 random multi-drone scenarios and covered crossing, touching, collinear-overlap and near-miss cases with 19 unit tests

Emergency Abort System - WARG
October 2026
Python, ROS 2, MAVROS
• Built an airside emergency-abort behaviour that checks the existing ground-station command stream at the beginning of each behaviour-tree cycle
• On ABORT, commands LAND mode through MAVROS and stops the behaviour tree from continuing the mission

Recall - AI Study Assistant Chrome Extension

Bedside Patient Monitoring System
